justification: New data pipeline + new DB table. Not Critical because no user-facing output, payments, or legal compliance text.

pre_impl.existing_data: New table nsw_cadastre_lots — no existing table. PostGIS extension already enabled.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: FeatureServer field names wrong → 400 error on query. Verified field names against layer metadata (29 fields, all lowercase except Shape__*).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: N/A — new table. Re-runs use UPSERT on lotidstring unique constraint, idempotent.

functions.name: get_count
functions.input: str WHERE clause plus optional spatial params dict from CLI args
functions.output: int record count from FeatureServer returnCountOnly query response
functions.if_none: where defaults to '1=1' → returns total count

functions.name: fetch_page
functions.input: str WHERE clause, int page offset, optional spatial params dict
functions.output: dict Esri JSON response with features list and exceededTransferLimit flag
functions.if_none: Returns {'features': []} after 3 retry attempts with backoff

functions.name: esri_rings_to_multipolygon_wkt
functions.input: list of ring coordinate arrays from Esri JSON geometry object
functions.output: Optional str WKT MultiPolygon representation for PostGIS insertion
functions.if_none: Returns None which causes the row to be skipped in build_rows

functions.name: build_rows
functions.input: list of dict features from Esri JSON API response page
functions.output: list of tuple rows ready for psycopg2 execute_values DB insertion
functions.if_none: Returns empty list which means nothing gets inserted for this page

functions.name: upsert_rows
functions.input: psycopg2 cursor plus list of tuple rows from build_rows
functions.output: DB side-effect INSERT or UPDATE via ON CONFLICT upsert
functions.if_none: Empty rows list is never passed since caller guards with if rows check

functions.name: validate_ingest
functions.input: psycopg2 cursor plus human-readable label string for report header
functions.output: stdout validation report with row counts and urbanity distribution
functions.if_none: Prints zero counts for empty table which is a valid state

functions.name: ingest
functions.input: where clause, label, dry_run flag, DB connection, db_url for reconnection, optional row limit, optional spatial params
functions.output: tuple of int total rows ingested and connection object across all pages
functions.if_none: Zero count from get_count returns 0 immediately without any DB operations

functions.name: get_lga_bbox
functions.input: psycopg2 connection plus LGA name string from CLI --lga argument
functions.output: Optional tuple of four floats representing xmin ymin xmax ymax bounding box
functions.if_none: Returns None which causes caller to print error and exit with code 1

functions.name: get_last_sync
functions.input: psycopg2 connection to query existing nsw_cadastre_lots table
functions.output: Optional datetime representing MAX modifieddate for incremental sync cutoff
functions.if_none: Returns None which triggers full ingest fallback instead of incremental

queries.purpose: UPSERT cadastre lots into nsw_cadastre_lots table
queries.where_clause: ON CONFLICT (lotidstring) DO UPDATE SET all columns
queries.if_zero: Nothing to insert which is correct for empty page
queries.if_wrong: UPSERT overwrites with same data since source is authoritative

queries.purpose: Validation total row count after ingest completes
queries.where_clause: None — full table count via COUNT(*)
queries.if_zero: Returns 0 and prints it which is valid for dry-run mode
queries.if_wrong: N/A — COUNT(*) on full table cannot return wrong rows

queries.purpose: LGA bounding box lookup from spatial_overlays zone layer
queries.if_zero: Returns None causing exit with error message and hint to run spatial overlay ingest
queries.if_wrong: Could return wrong bbox if lga_name doesn't match — mitigated by exact string match

break_it.scenario: FeatureServer 500/503 during multi-page ingest at page 50 of 1675
break_it.what_happens: 3 retries per page then skips. Already-committed pages safe due to per-page commit.
break_it.how: ingest_cadastre.py:100-107 retry loop with exponential backoff + ingest_cadastre.py:354 conn.commit() per page
break_it.repro: python scripts/ingest_cadastre.py --scope all (wait for network interruption or manually block outbound traffic mid-run)

break_it.scenario: Invalid Esri geometry with self-intersecting or degenerate polygon rings
break_it.what_happens: Shapely Polygon constructor may produce invalid geometry that fails PostGIS insertion
break_it.how: ingest_cadastre.py:196 — valid_polygons filters on p.is_valid and not p.is_empty
break_it.repro: python scripts/ingest_cadastre.py --scope all --limit 100000 (degenerate rings occur naturally in rural lots)

break_it.scenario: Duplicate lotidstring across overlapping pages from bbox spatial query
break_it.what_happens: ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE overwrites with identical data from second occurrence
break_it.how: ingest_cadastre.py:255 UPSERT on lotidstring unique constraint makes this idempotent
break_it.repro: python scripts/ingest_cadastre.py --lga 'INNER WEST' && python scripts/ingest_cadastre.py --lga 'INNER WEST' (run twice)

break_it.scenario: UPSERT fails mid-batch due to invalid WKT geometry causing PostGIS parse error
break_it.what_happens: Transaction rolls back for that page, losing up to 2000 rows
break_it.how: ingest_cadastre.py:196 pre-filters invalid geometries. ST_GeomFromText on valid WKT won't fail.
break_it.repro: python scripts/ingest_cadastre.py --scope all --limit 50000 (check for ST_GeomFromText errors in output)

break_it.scenario: Validation query runs on empty table during dry-run mode
break_it.what_happens: validate_ingest prints zero counts which is confusing but not harmful
break_it.how: ingest_cadastre.py:361 — validate_ingest only called when not dry_run
break_it.repro: python scripts/ingest_cadastre.py --dry-run --limit 2000 (verify no validation section printed)

break_it.scenario: LGA bbox lookup returns wrong extent because spatial_overlays zone data is stale or incomplete for that LGA
break_it.what_happens: Spatial query fetches lots from wrong area — either too few lots or lots from neighbouring LGAs
break_it.how: ingest_cadastre.py:399 adds 0.001 degree buffer to bbox. Zone layer covers full LGA by definition. Missing LGA → returns None → exit with hint.
break_it.repro: python scripts/ingest_cadastre.py --lga 'NONEXISTENT COUNCIL' (should exit with error + hint)
